intro_commit_message:
Add support for client pause WRITE (#8170)

Implementation of client pause WRITE and client unpause
fix_commit_message:
Fix potential infinite loop of RANDOMKEY during client pause (#13863)

The bug mentioned in this
[#13862](https://github.com/redis/redis/issues/13862) has been fixed.

---------

Signed-off-by: li-benson <1260437731@qq.com>
Signed-off-by: youngmore1024 <youngmore1024@outlook.com>
Co-authored-by: youngmore1024 <youngmore1024@outlook.com>
agent_reasoning: Without this change, dbRandomKey()'s while(1) loop only bails out via the maxtries counter when `server.masterhost` is set (i.e., on a replica). Once CLIENT PAUSE WRITE/ALL was introduced, expireIfNeeded() gained a second path where it returns "expired" without deleting the key whenever the server is paused — including on a primary. If a primary's keyspace consists entirely of volatile, already-expired keys and the server is paused, dbRandomKey() repeatedly draws the same expired key, expireIfNeeded() refuses to remove it, and the maxtries condition (gated only on masterhost) never fires, causing an infinite loop that hangs the single-threaded event loop (DoS). Adding `|| areClientsPaused()` to the maxtries condition restores the invariant that the safety valve fires whenever expireIfNeeded() can leave an expired key in place without eventually returning 0.
